summary: Implemented the wcwidth core under wcwidth/: binary interval search, wcwidth() via the zero-width and wide tables, wcswidth() with ZWJ skipping and VS-16 widening for Unicode 9.0+, _wcversion_value() and nearest-version matching in _wcmatch_version() with warnings for invalid or too-low versions, and list_versions() in unicode_versions.py. The last full-suite run was 37 passed, 1 failed, 1 skipped; the failure is test_package_version, which needs installed wcwidth distribution metadata that the jail interpreter does not have and that code under wcwidth/ cannot supply.
